paras.en: We linearly anneal the learning rate from \(2.5 \times 10^{-4}\) to \(1 \times 10^{-6}\) for 50,000 steps in BF16 precision with purposely curated high-quality datasets. The context length is initially maintained at 8k tokens for the first 30,000 steps, then extended to 32k, 128k, and 256k for 10,000, 5,000, and 5,000 steps respectively by interleaving long-context pre-training data every fourth step. During the long-context stages, we adjust the overall ratio of datasets to ensure a balanced mixture across domains (Fu et al., 2024), while maintaining a sufficient proportion of long-context data.
paras.zh: 我们在 BF16 精度下，将学习率从 \(2.5 \times 10^{-4}\) 线性退火到 \(1 \times 10^{-6}\)，持续 50,000 步，并使用精心挑选的高质量数据集。上下文长度最初在前 30,000 步保持为 8k 个 token，随后分别扩展到 32k、128k 和 256k，各持续 10,000、5,000 和 5,000 步，方法是每第四步交错插入长上下文预训练数据。在长上下文阶段，我们调整数据集的整体比例，以确保跨领域的平衡混合（Fu et al., 2024），同时保持足够比例的长上下文数据。

paras.en: Command A is post-trained using a novel decentralised approach to maximise and control its performance over a wide spectrum of domains and capability areas. More precisely, Command A is trained by alternating centralised training stages, where a single model is fine-tuned, and decentralised training stages, where multiple expert models are trained separately to maximise domain-wise performance before merging their parameters. Although the classic post-training paradigm involves training a single model sequentially with varying data-mixtures (Dubey et al., 2024; Team et al., 2024), Command A is the first large-scale attempt to combine multiple parallel expert tracks, with parameter merging techniques playing a central role. This section details the high-level post-training recipe of Command A, illustrated in Figure 3.
paras.zh: Command A 采用一种新颖的分散式方法进行后训练，以在广泛领域和能力范围内最大化并控制其性能。更准确地说，Command A 的训练过程交替进行集中式训练阶段和分散式训练阶段：在集中式阶段，对单个模型进行微调；在分散式阶段，多个专家模型分别训练以最大化领域性能，然后合并其参数。尽管经典的后训练范式是使用不同的数据混合方式顺序训练单个模型（Dubey et al., 2024; Team et al., 2024），Command A 是首次大规模尝试将多个并行专家轨道结合起来，参数合并技术在其中发挥了核心作用。本节详细介绍 Command A 的顶层后训练方案，如图 3 所示。

paras.en:
We divide the global Command A post-training recipe into several sub-stages, each producing intermediary model artifacts:
• Instruct Model: We train an initial Instruct model with supervised learning on top of the base model to provide the core basic capabilities of the model.
• SFT Expert Models: We train six SFT experts on top of the Instruct checkpoint with specialised data mixtures to maximise capability-specific performance.
• SFT Soup Model: We merge the six model experts into a Soup model with parameter-merging methods (see Section 3.4) to produce a single SFT aggregate model.
paras.zh:
我们将 Command A 的全局后训练方案划分为若干子阶段，每个子阶段产生中间模型产物：
• 指令模型：我们在基础模型之上通过监督学习训练一个初始指令模型，以提供模型的核心基本能力。
• SFT 专家模型：我们在指令检查点之上训练六个 SFT 专家，使用专用数据混合以最大化特定能力的性能。
• SFT Soup 模型：我们使用参数合并方法（见第 3.4 节）将六个专家模型合并为一个 Soup 模型，以生成一个单一的 SFT 聚合模型。

paras.en:
• RL Expert Models: We train six RL experts on top of the SFT Soup checkpoint using RL algorithms tailored to each domain, using pairwise comparisons or verifiable rewards.
• RL Soup Model: We merge the six RL experts into a RL Soup model with parameter-merging methods to produce a single RL aggregate model.
• Polished Model: We perform a final stage on the RL Soup model to enhance human interaction performance by alternating between best-of-N methods, offline preference, and online RL algorithms.
paras.zh:
• RL 专家模型：我们在 SFT Soup 检查点之上训练六个 RL 专家，使用针对每个领域定制的 RL 算法，利用成对比较或可验证奖励。
• RL Soup 模型：我们使用参数合并方法将六个 RL 专家合并为一个 RL Soup 模型，以生成一个单一的 RL 聚合模型。
• 精炼模型：我们对 RL Soup 模型进行最后阶段处理，通过交替使用 best-of-N 方法、离线偏好和在线 RL 算法来增强人机交互性能。

paras.en: Six expert models are created at each expert stage: Code, Safety, RAG, Math, Multilingual, and a General Long-Context expert. This approach allows us to adapt each expert’s training procedure, tailoring it to the specific capability or domain of interest. This allows fine-grained hyperparameter tuning, specialised data mixture optimisation, local optimisation (e.g., seed merging), and the capability-specific selection of the most appropriate algorithms. This becomes even more crucial during the RL stage, as different domains demand distinct RL techniques — for example, verifiable rewards for Math and Code, or preference pairs for Safety and Multilingual. Our late-merging procedure allows us to re-balance Soup model performance a posteriori without requiring additional training (§3.4). From an organisational perspective, merging allows contributors to collaborate closely in parallel, fostering a unique model development synergy. Overall, this decentralised training procedure maximises individual expert performance while controlling the final global model capacity, allowing us to optimise both model performance and efficiency.
paras.zh: 在每个专家阶段会创建六个专家模型：代码、安全、RAG、数学、多语言和通用长上下文专家。这种方法使我们能够调整每个专家的训练流程，使其适应特定的能力或领域。这允许进行细粒度的超参数调优、专用数据混合优化、局部优化（例如种子合并），以及针对具体能力选择最合适的算法。这在 RL 阶段尤为重要，因为不同领域需要不同的 RL 技术——例如，数学和代码需要可验证奖励，而安全和多语言需要偏好对。我们的后期合并流程使我们能够在事后重新平衡 Soup 模型的性能，而无需额外训练（第 3.4 节）。从组织角度来看，合并使贡献者能够紧密并行协作，促进独特的模型开发协同效应。总体而言，这种分散式训练流程在控制最终全局模型能力的同时最大化了个体专家性能，使我们能够同时优化模型性能和效率。

paras.en: Finally, the model undergoes a polishing phase to improve its writing style. First, we apply a best-of-N supervised training stage to the RL Soup model. Then, we alternate between offline preference and online RL optimisation in a ping-pong approach, iterating as required until we observe a human preference performance plateau, to obtain the final Command A model.
paras.zh: 最后，模型进入润色阶段以改进其写作风格。首先，我们对 RL Soup 模型应用一个 best-of-N 监督训练阶段。然后，我们以交替迭代的方式在离线偏好和在线 RL 优化之间切换，按需迭代，直到观察到人类偏好性能达到平台期，从而获得最终的 Command A 模型。

paras.en: In the following sections, we introduce the methods and algorithms that we use at various stages of the post-training process. We detail individual expert recipe considerations and provide further technical details on the merging techniques applied. Finally, we discuss key features of the model polishing phase.
paras.zh: 在接下来的章节中，我们介绍在后训练过程的不同阶段所使用的方法和算法。我们详细说明各个专家方案的考量，并进一步提供所应用的合并技术的技术细节。最后，我们讨论模型打磨阶段的关键特性。

paras.en: 3.2.1 Supervised Fine-Tuning. In all cases, the first stage of our post-training pipeline involves fine-tuning the pretrained model to follow instructions and operate in a conversational setting. We structure Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) (Wei et al., 2021; Sanh et al., 2021) datapoints as prompts and completions. Prompts are model input sequences that may contain information such as preambles or system prompts defining expected model behaviour, tool specifications, conversational history, special tokens (e.g., <|START_OF_TURN_TOKEN|> or <|SYSTEM_TOKEN|>), and queries or instructions. Completions refer to the sequence of tokens that the model is trained to generate conditioned on a given prompt. We train the model using a cross-entropy loss with the loss corresponding to prompt tokens masked out. Depending on the specific setting, we may choose to regularise training either by including some small proportion of pretraining data, or a parameter-based L2 penalty to the pretrained model. We optimise using the AdamW algorithm (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017) with decoupled weight decay.
paras.zh: 3.2.1 监督微调。在所有情况下，我们后训练流程的第一阶段都是对预训练模型进行微调，使其能够遵循指令并在对话场景中运行。我们将监督微调（SFT）(Wei et al., 2021; Sanh et al., 2021) 的数据点组织为提示（prompts）和补全（completions）。提示是模型输入序列，可包含诸如前言或定义预期模型行为的系统提示、工具规范、对话历史、特殊词元（例如 <|START_OF_TURN_TOKEN|> 或 <|SYSTEM_TOKEN|>）以及查询或指令等信息。补全是指模型在给定提示条件下被训练生成的词元序列。我们使用交叉熵损失训练模型，并屏蔽与提示词元对应的损失。根据具体设置，我们可能选择通过加入少量预训练数据或对预训练模型施加基于参数的 L2 惩罚来正则化训练。我们使用 AdamW 算法 (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017) 进行优化，并采用解耦权重衰减。

paras.en: 3.2.2 Reinforcement Learning. Depending on the stage and task, we perform direct alignment using preference training (Rafailov et al., 2024; Azar et al., 2024) or we optimise for a reward signal through reinforcement learning (RL) (Sutton et al., 2023), either offline or online. This reward signal can be the learnt reward model, or a verifiable reward (for example, based on unit tests for code generation or on response correctness for reasoning).
paras.zh: 3.2.2 强化学习。根据阶段和任务的不同，我们使用偏好训练 (Rafailov et al., 2024; Azar et al., 2024) 进行直接对齐，或者通过强化学习（RL）(Sutton et al., 2023) 离线或在线地优化奖励信号。该奖励信号可以是学习得到的奖励模型，也可以是可验证的奖励（例如，基于代码生成的单元测试或推理的回复正确性）。

paras.en: 3.2.2.1 Preference Training with Self-refinement. We consider preference training methods for learning offline from preference datasets: Sequence Likelihood Calibration, or SLiC (Zhao et al., 2023), Direct Preference Optimisation, or DPO (Rafailov et al., 2024), and Identity Preference Optimisation, or IPO (Azar et al., 2024). In addition to these conventional preference-training methods, our model-training pipeline incorporates our novel Self-improving Robust Preference Optimisation (SRPO) (Choi et al., 2025). This recently-developed approach represents a significant departure
paras.zh: 3.2.2.1 具有自我优化的偏好训练。我们考虑了从偏好数据集中离线学习的偏好训练方法：序列似然校准（SLiC）(Zhao et al., 2023)、直接偏好优化（DPO）(Rafailov et al., 2024) 和身份偏好优化（IPO）(Azar et al., 2024)。除了这些传统的偏好训练方法之外，我们的模型训练流程还引入了我们提出的新型自改进鲁棒偏好优化（SRPO）(Choi et al., 2025)。这种近期开发的方法代表着一种重大偏离

paras.en: from traditional preference training techniques, introducing a novel mechanism for continuously enhancing model alignment and robustness. It amounts to solving the following min-max optimisation problem: \[ \min_{\pi} \max_{\pi^{\dagger}} \mathbb{E}_{x} \mathbb{E}_{y_1 \sim \pi(\cdot|x), y_2 \sim \pi^{\dagger}(\cdot|x, y_1)} \left[ P(y_2 \succ y_1|x) - \beta \mathrm{KL}(\pi^{\dagger} || \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}|x, y_1) + \beta \mathrm{KL}(\pi || \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}|x) \right] \]
paras.zh: 从传统的偏好训练技术出发，我们引入了一种新机制，用于持续增强模型的对齐性和鲁棒性。该机制本质上是在求解以下最小-最大优化问题：\[ \min_{\pi} \max_{\pi^{\dagger}} \mathbb{E}_{x} \mathbb{E}_{y_1 \sim \pi(\cdot|x), y_2 \sim \pi^{\dagger}(\cdot|x, y_1)} \left[ P(y_2 \succ y_1|x) - \beta \mathrm{KL}(\pi^{\dagger} || \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}|x, y_1) + \beta \mathrm{KL}(\pi || \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}|x) \right] \]

paras.en: This objective function aims to learn a self-improvement policy \(\pi^{\dagger}\) that can improve generations from \(\pi\), according to the preference model \(P\) without deviating too much from a reference model \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}\), and at the same time learning a policy \(\pi\) whose generations cannot be improved by \(\pi^{\dagger}\). SRPO’s novelty partly lies in its robustness: unlike classical methods, it does not depend on the sampling distribution of the preference dataset. This independence ensures greater generalisation and stability in varied deployment scenarios. Furthermore, SRPO uniquely enables iterative self-revision at inference time, a process where the model sequentially refines its output: Given an initial prompt, the model first generates an initial completion using the generative policy \(\pi\), followed by multiple sequential refinements through the self-refinement policy \(\pi^{\dagger}\), each progressively improving the quality and alignment of the final output. This iterative refinement capability is not present in conventional alignment pipelines, underscoring SRPO’s innovative contribution.
paras.zh: 该目标函数旨在学习一个自我改进策略 \(\pi^{\dagger}\)，它能够根据偏好模型 \(P\) 改进 \(\pi\) 生成的输出，同时又不会过于偏离参考模型 \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}\)，同时学习一个策略 \(\pi\)，使得它的生成无法被 \(\pi^{\dagger}\) 改进。SRPO 的新颖性部分在于其鲁棒性：与经典方法不同，它不依赖于偏好数据集的采样分布。这种独立性确保了在多种部署场景下的更好的泛化性和稳定性。此外，SRPO 独特地支持推理时的迭代自我修正，即模型顺序优化其输出的过程：给定初始提示后，模型首先生成初始补全（使用生成策略 \(\pi\)），然后通过自我修正策略 \(\pi^{\dagger}\) 进行多次顺序修正，每一步都逐步提高最终输出的质量和对齐性。这种迭代修正能力是传统对齐流程所不具备的，凸显了 SRPO 的创新贡献。

paras.en:
3.3.1 Instruction-Following
Core instruction-following capabilities are crucial for LLMs to solve tasks across areas and domains. We therefore consider instruction-following a prerequisite for more specific model capabilities focusing on advanced topics such as code, multilingual, and reasoning. As such, in the Command A post-training recipe, we teach the model to follow instructions across a wide range of topics and domains, including but not limited to generalist instruction-following (e.g., factual knowledge requests), formatting, STEM-specific tasks (e.g., tabular reasoning, structured data manipulation), and preamble compliance. Instruction-following capabilities are acquired both via SFT and offline preference tuning.
paras.zh:
3.3.1 指令遵循
核心指令遵循能力对于大语言模型（LLM）跨领域、跨学科解决任务至关重要。因此，我们认为指令遵循是更具体模型能力（如代码、多语言和推理等高级主题）的前提。基于此，在 Command A 的后训练方案中，我们教导模型遵循广泛主题和领域的指令，包括但不限于通用指令遵循（如事实性知识请求）、格式要求、STEM 特定任务（如表格推理、结构化数据操作）以及前言遵循。指令遵循能力通过 SFT 和离线偏好调整两方面获得。

paras.en:
3.3.1.1 Data collection
Our data collection approach can be divided based on the post-training method, i.e., SFT or preference tuning. To collect datasets that serve both of these, we primarily rely on synthetic prompt generation in conjunction with human annotation, and explore various sampling and filtering techniques (Bartolo et al., 2021). Specifically, we synthetically generate diverse sets of prompts covering a range of instructions tailored to individual domains (such domains are mostly enterprise-oriented) and generate two completions per prompt sampled with different temperatures. We then ask human annotators to provide discrete ratings for both completions. This process is repeated over multiple turns, resulting in a multi-turn dataset. If the two completion ratings are not tied and the better completion does not obtain the highest possible rating, we ask the annotator to improve the better completion.
paras.zh:
3.3.1.1 数据收集
我们的数据收集方法可根据后训练方法（即 SFT 或偏好调整）进行划分。为了收集服务于这两者的数据集，我们主要依赖合成提示生成与人工标注相结合，并探索多种采样和过滤技术（Bartolo 等，2021）。具体而言，我们合成生成多样化的提示集，涵盖针对各个领域（这些领域大多面向企业）的一系列指令，并以不同的温度参数对每个提示采样生成两个补全。然后，我们要求人工标注者对两个补全都给出离散评分。此过程在多个对话轮次中重复，最终形成多轮数据集。如果两个补全的评分不一致，且较优的补全未获得最高可能评分，我们要求标注者改进该较优补全。

paras.en: SFT samples. SFT datasets are constructed using the human rewrites obtained from the process mentioned above, to ensure the highest completion quality.
paras.zh: SFT 样本。SFT 数据集使用上述过程中获得的人工改写来构建，以确保最高的补全质量。

paras.en: Preference pairs. We construct preference pairs directly from the obtained samples by considering completions with different ratings (including the human rewrites), with ties excluded. It is worth noting that the obtained preference samples are used to train both Command A and our reward model itself.
paras.zh: 偏好对。我们直接通过考虑具有不同评分（包括人工改写）的补全来构建偏好对，并排除评分相同的情况。值得注意的是，所获得的偏好样本既用于训练 Command A，也用于训练我们自身的奖励模型。

paras.en:
3.3.1.2 Iterative Reward-based Sample Refinement
We further experiment with reward-based sample refinement approaches to obtain both SFT and preference pairs using the synthetically-generated prompts. Similar to Dubey et al. (2024), we use internal reward models trained on our most recent Command A checkpoints in conjunction with a collection of both human-written completions and completions generated from different checkpoints under different conditions (e.g., varying temperature values) during post-training. This implies that the resulting dataset does not contain purely synthetic completions, and human-written completions are retained for inputs where the models fail to generate high-quality completions. We approach this in an iterative fashion, where we use the most recent checkpoints at a given point in time to generate completions, score those completions using our reward model, create preference pairs and SFT samples using the scores, re-train our models, and repeat.
paras.zh:
3.3.1.2 基于奖励的迭代式样本精炼
我们进一步尝试了基于奖励的样本精炼方法，以利用合成生成的提示获得 SFT 样本和偏好对。与 Dubey 等人（2024）类似，我们使用基于最新 Command A 检查点训练的内部奖励模型，并结合人工撰写的补全以及在后训练期间不同条件下（如不同温度值）由不同检查点生成的补全。这意味着最终数据集不包含纯粹合成的补全，并且对于模型无法生成高质量补全的输入，会保留人工撰写的补全。我们以迭代的方式进行：使用当前时间点的最新检查点生成补全，用奖励模型对这些补全进行评分，根据评分创建偏好对和 SFT 样本，重新训练模型，然后重复此过程。

paras.en:
3.3.1.3 Preambles
A specific focus of the instruction-following post-training of Command A lies in the model’s ability to follow preamble (or system prompt) requirements. Preambles are designed to contain instructions that should apply to an entire conversation and potentially multiple model inputs, meaning that instead of having to repeat instructions in every prompt, they can be defined directly in the preamble. Such system instructions could specify what language the model should reply in (e.g., “Always respond in French.”), the desired format of model generations (e.g., “Always use JSON.”, “Do not generate Markdown.”), or the exclusion of specific words and phrases (e.g., “Do not use the word ‘LLM’ in your response.”). To train Command A to follow preamble instructions, we develop methods based on synthetic data generation to create diverse preambles that are attached to prompts flowing into the above-described pipeline. The preambles are then taken into account when creating the respective completions and preferences, i.e., preamble-augmented data is used during both SFT and preference tuning. During preamble generation, we aim to maximise instruction diversity to encourage robustness to a wide range of instructions at inference time.
paras.zh:
3.3.1.3 前言
Command A 的指令跟随后训练的一个重点在于模型遵循前言（或系统提示）要求的能力。前言旨在包含适用于整个对话及可能多个模型输入的指令，这意味着无需在每个提示中重复指令，而可以直接在前言中定义。此类系统指令可以指定模型应使用的回复语言（例如“始终用法语回复。”）、模型输出的预期格式（例如“始终使用 JSON。”、“不要生成 Markdown。”），或排除特定词语和短语（例如“在你的回复中不要使用‘LLM’这个词。”）。为了训练 Command A 遵循前言指令，我们基于合成数据生成开发了方法来创建多样的前言，并将这些前言附加到流入上述流程的提示中。在生成相应补全和偏好时会将前言纳入考虑，即前言增强数据在监督微调（SFT）和偏好调优中均被使用。在前言生成过程中，我们旨在最大化指令多样性，以鼓励在推理时对广泛指令的鲁棒性。

paras.en:
3.3.1.4 Model training
In the context of instruction-following we post-train Command A in sequence with SFT and preference tuning. For preference tuning, we experiment with a range of methods, including SLiC, IPO, DPO, and SRPO (for further details, see Section 3.2.2). We find that SRPO performs best across evaluation tasks and select a checkpoint trained using SRPO for the final Instruct model.
paras.zh:
3.3.1.4 模型训练
在指令跟随的背景下，我们依次使用 SFT 和偏好调优对 Command A 进行后训练。对于偏好调优，我们尝试了多种方法，包括 SLiC、IPO、DPO 和 SRPO（更多细节见第 3.2.2 节）。我们发现 SRPO 在各项评估任务中表现最佳，因此选择使用 SRPO 训练的检查点作为最终 Instruct 模型。

paras.en:
3.3.2 Retrieval Augmented Generation, Tool Use and Agents
Recent breakthroughs have propelled LLMs beyond simple chatbots, transforming them into versatile agents capable of navigating complex environments. At the heart of this evolution is their ability to use tools strategically: invoking APIs, analysing results, and iterating dynamically to accomplish goals. This agentic behaviour is pivotal for two key advancements. First, integrating knowledge sources outside of model parameters (e.g., via Retrieval-Augmented Generation, or RAG) mitigates hallucinations and ensures accurate information beyond the timespan of model training. Second, agentic frameworks empower models to orchestrate vast action chains, potentially executing hundreds of API calls to automate intricate workflows. Together, these capabilities expand LLMs’ operational horizons, enabling them to tackle tasks once deemed beyond their reach.
paras.zh:
3.3.2 检索增强生成、工具使用与智能体
近期的突破已将大语言模型从简单的聊天机器人推向多功能智能体，使其能够驾驭复杂环境。这一演变的核心在于它们策略性地使用工具的能力：调用 API、分析结果，并动态迭代以达成目标。这种智能体式行为对两项关键进展至关重要。首先，整合模型参数之外的知识源（例如通过检索增强生成，即 RAG）可缓解幻觉，并确保超出模型训练时间范围的准确信息。其次，智能体式框架使模型能够编排庞大的行动链，可能执行数百次 API 调用来自动化复杂的工作流程。这些能力共同拓展了大语言模型的操作视野，使其能够处理曾经被认为超出其能力范围的任务。

paras.en:
3.3.2.1 Agentic Tool-Use
Empowering LLMs with Tools. LLMs have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in leveraging external tools to enhance their capabilities (Schick et al., 2023). By generating API calls, models can execute specific actions—like performing calculations or retrieving information—to solve tasks more effectively. This process typically involves providing a set of tool definitions in the model’s preamble. When faced with a task, the model selects and invokes the appropriate tools, and the results are fed back to inform its final response.
paras.zh:
3.3.2.1 智能体式工具使用
用工具赋能大语言模型。大语言模型在利用外部工具增强自身能力方面展现了卓越的熟练度（Schick et al., 2023）。通过生成 API 调用，模型可以执行特定操作——如进行计算或检索信息——从而更有效地解决问题。此过程通常涉及在模型的前言中提供一组工具定义。当面对任务时，模型会选择合适的工具并调用它们，然后将结果反馈以生成最终响应。

paras.en: A prime example of this is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). In RAG (Lewis et al., 2020), the model has access to a search tool (e.g. a dense embedding index) to answer information-seeking queries. It generates search queries, retrieves relevant snippets from the selected knowledge source, and uses this context to craft a well-informed response.
paras.zh: 一个典型的例子是检索增强生成（RAG）。在 RAG（Lewis et al., 2020）中，模型可以访问搜索工具（例如密集嵌入索引）来回答信息型查询。它生成搜索查询，从选定的知识源中检索相关片段，并利用这些上下文构建一个充分知情的响应。

paras.en: Agents. For more intricate tasks, models may need to orchestrate multiple tools across several steps. This requires a structured approach to halt generation, extract tool calls, execute them, and reintroduce results into the model’s workflow—a process repeated until the task is resolved.
paras.zh: 智能体。对于更复杂的任务，模型可能需要跨多个步骤编排多种工具。这需要一种结构化方法：暂停生成、提取工具调用、执行工具，并将结果重新引入模型的工作流——重复该过程直到任务完成。

paras.en: We roughly follow the ReAct framework (Yao et al., 2022), a widely adopted method for guiding LLMs through dynamic problem-solving. ReAct enables models to interleave reasoning and action: they first articulate their thought process, outlining plans and tool requirements, then either execute a tool (via structured outputs like JSON) or deliver a final answer. This iterative loop enables adaptive planning, reflection, and interaction with external systems, making it ideal for complex, multi-step tasks.
paras.zh: 我们大致遵循 ReAct 框架（Yao et al., 2022），这是一种广泛采用的引导大语言模型（LLM）进行动态问题求解的方法。ReAct 让模型能够交错进行推理与行动：模型首先阐述其思考过程，概述计划和工具需求，然后要么通过 JSON 等结构化输出执行工具，要么给出最终答案。这种迭代循环支持自适应规划、反思以及与外部系统的交互，因此非常适合复杂的多步任务。

paras.en: 3.3.2.2 Data and Training. We train our model on a combination of human-annotated and synthetically generated data. We collect datapoints in multiple languages for direct supervision, as well as datapoints with preference judgments for multiple completions. The data covers areas of code tool execution, user-uploaded documents, and general API environments. Training consists of an SFT step on agentic datasets followed by offline preference tuning using the Contrastive Policy Gradient loss (§3.2.2.2).
paras.zh: 3.3.2.2 数据与训练。我们使用人工标注与合成生成的数据相结合来训练模型。我们收集多种语言的数据点用于直接监督，以及包含对多个补全进行偏好判断的数据点。这些数据涵盖代码工具执行、用户上传文档和通用 API 环境等场景。训练流程包括在智能体式数据集上进行 SFT 步骤，然后使用对比策略梯度损失（§3.2.2.2）进行离线偏好调优。

paras.en: Data format. Each datapoint contains a user prompt along with a set of available tools and potentially custom model instructions that the user has provided to the model. The datapoint also contains a reasoning step, where the model reasons about which tools to use to fulfil the user request and how to fill in the input parameters of the tools. This is followed by tool calls and tool outputs, which can be concurrent or sequential. The datapoint concludes with a model response that includes citations to the tool outputs.
paras.zh: 数据格式。每个数据点包含用户提示、一组可用工具，以及用户可能提供给模型的自定义模型指令。数据点还包含一个推理步骤，模型在该步骤中思考应使用哪些工具来满足用户请求，以及如何填写工具的输入参数。随后是工具调用和工具输出，这些调用和输出可以是并发的，也可以是顺序的。数据点以模型响应结束，响应中包含对工具输出的引用。

paras.en: Data collection. Annotation is performed by internal annotators specifically trained in ReAct-style data. All annotated data used for SFT is reviewed multiple times by different annotators to ensure correctness and consistency.
paras.zh: 数据收集。标注由经过 ReAct 风格数据专门培训的内部标注人员完成。所有用于 SFT 的标注数据都会由不同的标注人员多次审核，以确保正确性和一致性。

paras.en: Quality. For preference data, we use a majority vote of at least 3 annotators to collect preference judgments.
paras.zh: 质量。对于偏好数据，我们采用至少 3 名标注者的多数投票来收集偏好判断。

paras.en: Synthetic data. We also generate synthetic training data containing whole trajectories of reasoning and tool calls. We verify the quality of the trajectories using internal LLMs-as-a-judge.
paras.zh: 合成数据。我们还生成包含完整推理轨迹和工具调用轨迹的合成训练数据，并使用内部 LLM 作为评判者来验证这些轨迹的质量。

paras.en: 3.3.3 Multilingual The ability to communicate in and understand multiple languages is a fundamental component of enterprise LLMs. Command A is designed to handle a wide array of languages, ensuring that information can be accessed and shared seamlessly across different linguistic communities. By incorporating solid multilingual capabilities in 23 languages, Command A enables businesses and individuals to reach a broader audience, fostering inclusivity and accessibility. Moreover, the multilingual aspect of Command A facilitates better understanding and collaboration among international teams, driving innovation and efficiency.
paras.zh: 3.3.3 多语言。以多种语言进行交流和理解的能力是企业级 LLM 的基本组成部分。Command A 旨在处理多种语言，确保信息能够在不同语言社区之间无缝访问和共享。通过融入覆盖 23 种语言的坚实多语言能力，Command A 使企业和个人能够触达更广泛的受众，促进包容性和可访问性。此外，Command A 的多语言特性有助于国际团队之间的理解和协作，推动创新与效率。

paras.en: 3.3.3.1 Data Mixture We focus our data mixture on 23 languages: English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Dutch, Czech, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Romanian, Greek, Hindi, Hebrew, and Persian. This ensures coverage to expand state-of-the-art language modelling capabilities to approximately half of the world's population (Aryabumi et al., 2024; Üstün et al., 2024). Our multilingual data mixture spans a diverse set of domains and tasks, covering machine translation, multilingual safety, multilingual reasoning, multilingual robust controllability, multilingual RAG, multilingual agents, etc; ensuring that Command A possesses strong generalisation capabilities across languages. The datasets are collected through various means including human annotation, multilingual data arbitrage (Odumakinde et al., 2024; Dang et al., 2024), templated public datasets, or machine translation. Our data mixture is specifically tailored to handle multilingual learning through SFT and offline preference tuning.
paras.zh: 3.3.3.1 数据混合。我们将数据混合重点放在 23 种语言上：英语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、德语、葡萄牙语、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语、中文、俄语、波兰语、土耳其语、越南语、荷兰语、捷克语、印尼语、乌克兰语、罗马尼亚语、希腊语、印地语、希伯来语和波斯语。这确保了覆盖范围，将最先进的语言建模能力扩展到全球约一半人口（Aryabumi 等，2024；Üstün 等，2024）。我们的多语言数据混合涵盖多种领域和任务，包括机器翻译、多语言安全、多语言推理、多语言稳健可控性、多语言 RAG、多语言智能体等，确保 Command A 具备跨语言的强泛化能力。这些数据集通过多种方式收集，包括人工标注、多语言数据套利（Odumakinde 等，2024；Dang 等，2024）、模板化公共数据集或机器翻译。我们的数据混合专门针对通过 SFT 和离线偏好调整来处理多语言学习而定制。

paras.en: 3.3.3.2 Multilingual Data Annotation Multilingual data annotation is performed by internal and external multilingual annotators who are expertly trained for annotation within various tasks. It can be divided into two distinct processes, i.e., regionally relevant data annotation and complex multilingual task annotation, which cover use cases for both SFT and preference tuning. For complex tasks such as domain-specific RAG, long-context reasoning, or agentic tool-use tasks, we conduct human annotation using two different approaches: 1) LLM-generated response with human post-editing; and 2) manually annotated human data. The prior helps us scale the quantity of data, while the latter helps develop high-quality multilingual data for tackling complex tasks. We develop a customised in-house data annotation platform that can support both of these use cases. The high-quality data generated from human annotations also helps to further improve the quality of the machine-generated responses providing a positive feedback loop within the annotation process.
paras.zh: 3.3.3.2 多语言数据标注。多语言数据标注由内部和外部多语言标注者执行，他们经过专业培训，能够完成各种任务中的标注。该过程可分为两个不同部分，即区域相关数据标注和复杂多语言任务标注，分别覆盖 SFT 和偏好调整的使用场景。对于领域特定 RAG、长上下文推理或智能体式工具使用任务等复杂任务，我们采用两种不同方法进行人工标注：1）LLM 生成响应并由人工进行后编辑；2）人工标注数据。前者帮助我们扩展数据数量，后者则有助于开发高质量的多语言数据以应对复杂任务。我们开发了一个定制的内部数据标注平台，可支持这两种使用场景。人工标注生成的高质量数据也有助于进一步提高机器生成响应的质量，从而在标注过程中形成正反馈循环。

paras.en: Multilingual Best-of-N. To further improve the multilingual quality of Command A, we conduct iterative synthetic data collection through multilingual best-of-N (Stiennon et al., 2020; Eisenstein et al., 2024). Using a collection of high-quality prompts, we collect responses from all expert models and score them using our internal reward models and select the best response to be used in our iterative training. This approach is very similar to multilingual arbitrage where the model is trained on responses from diverse teacher models. Using this approach, we observe from human evaluation that LLMs can produce responses that are comparable or even better than the human-written gold label provided in many multilingual datasets.
paras.zh: 多语言最佳-N。为了进一步提升 Command A 的多语言质量，我们通过多语言最佳-N（Stiennon 等人，2020；Eisenstein 等人，2024）进行迭代式合成数据收集。利用一组高质量提示，我们从所有专家模型中收集响应，并使用内部奖励模型对其进行评分，然后选择最佳响应用于迭代训练。这种方法与多语言套利非常相似，即模型在来自不同教师模型的响应上进行训练。通过这种方法，我们从人工评估中观察到，LLM 能够生成与许多多语言数据集提供的人工撰写的黄金标签相当甚至更优的响应。

paras.en: 3.3.3.3 Training. The multilingual expert model is trained via both SFT and Preference Tuning (full details in Appendix B.2). We find that training several models with the same configuration (but a different random seed) and uniformly merging them gives a slight performance boost for the expert at the SFT stage, but does not help at the preference tuning stage.
paras.zh: 3.3.3.3 训练。多语言专家模型通过 SFT 和偏好调优进行训练（完整细节见附录 B.2）。我们发现，用相同配置（但随机种子不同）训练多个模型并均匀合并，在 SFT 阶段会为专家带来轻微性能提升，但在偏好调优阶段没有帮助。

paras.en: 3.3.4 Code. Generating and understanding code is a fundamental requirement for any enterprise LLM. We invest in the code capabilities of Command A to assist the software development cycle and improve user coding experience. Command A’s success in code-oriented tasks is also a precise measurement of capability in instruction-following, pragmatic inference in interpreting prompts, and procedural reasoning. Our models excel in challenging business environments, including understanding and translating legacy programs in COBOL, and using SQL to interface with relational databases.
paras.zh: 3.3.4 代码。生成和理解代码是任何企业级 LLM 的基本要求。我们投资于 Command A 的代码能力，以辅助软件开发周期并改善用户编码体验。Command A 在面向代码任务上的成功，也是对指令遵循、解析提示时的实用推理以及程序性推理能力的精确度量。我们的模型在具有挑战性的业务环境中表现出色，包括理解和翻译 COBOL 遗留程序，以及使用 SQL 与关系数据库交互。

paras.en: 3.3.4.1 Data. Data Mixture. Our data mix focuses on 8 priority programming languages (Python, Java, C++, Rust, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, COBOL) and 5 dialects of SQL (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft TSQL, Oracle PL/SQL). Across these languages, we target a wide range of tasks including code generation (i.e., NL-to-code), code translation, and code optimisation. Within these tasks, we include diverse domains such as interview-style questions; repository-level queries; and enterprise-specific demands (including high-dimensional arrays, complex debugging, data processing, and visualisation).
paras.zh: 3.3.4.1 数据。数据混合。我们的数据混合聚焦于 8 种优先编程语言（Python、Java、C++、Rust、Go、JavaScript、TypeScript、COBOL）和 5 种 SQL 方言（SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL、Microsoft TSQL、Oracle PL/SQL）。在这些语言中，我们的目标涵盖广泛的任务，包括代码生成（即 NL-to-code）、代码翻译和代码优化。在这些任务中，我们包含多样化的领域，如面试风格问题；仓库级查询；以及企业特定需求（包括高维数组、复杂调试、数据处理和可视化）。

paras.en: Prompts and completions are sourced from annotation campaigns and synthetic generation pipelines. We enrich prompt-completion pairs with additional information including execution feedback, explanations, paraphrases, stack traces, database context (Chang & Fosler-Lussier, 2023), diff patch formats, and unit-testing requirements. We prioritize candidate data with positive execution-based validation to filter erroneous or unverifiable code. This includes passing gold-standard unit tests or correct and error-free execution within a database. We use a multi-language code execution sandbox to evaluate code correctness in an isolated environment similar to Guo et al. (2024) and Team et al. (2025).
paras.zh: 提示和补全来自标注活动和合成生成管道。我们通过额外信息丰富提示-补全对，包括执行反馈、解释、释义、堆栈跟踪、数据库上下文（Chang & Fosler-Lussier, 2023）、diff 补丁格式和单元测试要求。我们优先选择具有积极执行验证的候选数据，以过滤错误或无法验证的代码。这包括通过黄金标准单元测试，或在数据库中正确且无错误地执行。我们使用多语言代码执行沙箱，在隔离环境中评估代码正确性，类似于 Guo 等人（2024）和 Team 等人（2025）。

paras.en: During pretraining, we perform execution-based code data enrichment. We isolate self-contained functions and files and add print statements of some variables and generate synthetically valid input parameters. The resulting code is executed in a sandbox and the output is appended to the enriched source code, adding several billion pretraining tokens. There is the added benefit that a subset of code repositories can be formatted as a very long document where files are linearised following a graph traversal defined by import links.
paras.zh: 在预训练阶段，我们执行基于执行的代码数据增强。我们分离出自包含的函数和文件，为一些变量添加打印语句，并生成合成有效的输入参数。所得代码在沙箱中执行，输出被附加到增强后的源代码中，增加了数十亿的预训练标记。还有一个额外的好处是，一部分代码仓库可以格式化为一个非常长的文档，其中文件按照由导入链接定义的图遍历进行线性化。

paras.en: In the RL stage, we jointly optimise for code correctness and annotated preferences between code completions. This approach enhances both the functional accuracy of generated code and reduces edit times of technically correct but suboptimal or dispreferred generations. We quantify performance using the proportion of unit tests passed in our code execution sandbox, where a reward of 1.0 indicates 100% test success and 0.2 represents 20% test success. When no valid code block is detected, we assign a reward of −1.0 to explicitly penalize non-code output. We use synthetic unit-test generation ensuring all code completions have a minimum of 4 tests per sample. Our synthetic test generation pipeline is similar to Zeng et al. (2025) with more robust unittest tests over assert statements. The preferred SQL completions are canonicalised using static query analysis. Beyond verifiable metrics, we incorporate DPO-style preference pairs (Rafailov et al., 2024) to optimise for code style conventions, documentation structure, and formatting consistency.
paras.zh: 在强化学习（RL）阶段，我们联合优化代码正确性和代码补全之间的标注偏好。这种方法既提高了生成代码的功能准确性，又减少了技术上正确但次优或不受欢迎的生成的编辑时间。我们通过代码执行沙箱中通过的单元测试比例来量化性能，其中奖励1.0表示100%测试成功，0.2表示20%测试成功。当未检测到有效的代码块时，我们分配−1.0的奖励以显式惩罚非代码输出。我们使用合成单元测试生成，确保所有代码补全每个样本至少有4个测试。我们的合成测试生成流程类似于Zeng等人（2025），但在断言语句上使用更健壮的单元测试。首选SQL补全通过静态查询分析进行规范化。除了可验证的指标外，我们还纳入了DPO风格偏好对（Rafailov等人，2024），以优化代码风格约定、文档结构和格式一致性。

paras.en: Synthetic Data. We experiment with synthetic data pipelines for post-training data enrichment. As a result, a high proportion of our data are verified synthetic examples in many coding languages. For synthetic generation sources, we exploit our highest performing models for code, and generalist models for explanations and reasoning. We experiment with both novel data synthesis and conditional synthetic data augmentation.
paras.zh: 合成数据。我们尝试了用于后训练数据增强的合成数据流水线。因此，我们数据中的很大一部分是许多编程语言中经过验证的合成示例。对于合成生成源，我们利用我们性能最高的代码模型，以及用于解释和推理的通用模型。我们既尝试了新的数据合成，也尝试了条件合成数据增强。

paras.en: Our novel data synthesis efforts include generating examples taking inspiration from concepts, similar to StarCoder (Wei et al., 2024), and sampling pretraining programming queries. We explore pipelines where our synthesis is Python-only followed by translating code and unit tests into additional languages, or direct generation into any programming language. While the former is useful for generating parallel corpora and targeting Python benchmarks, the latter pipeline proves valuable for problems using absent or uncommon features of Python (e.g., multithreading or memory management for C++). We use our execution sandbox to verify all synthetic completions — ensuring that any synthetic example teaches a novel skill via verified code. This approach to data synthesis only improves performance for small models (i.e., data-based distillation from larger models). Novel synthesis methods yield negligible improvement for larger models, instead requiring
paras.zh: 我们的新数据合成工作包括：从概念中汲取灵感生成示例（类似于StarCoder（Wei等人，2024）），并对预训练编程查询进行采样。我们探索了以下流水线：仅使用Python进行合成，然后将代码和单元测试翻译成其他语言；或者直接生成任何编程语言。前者对于生成平行语料库和针对Python基准测试很有用，而后者对于使用Python缺失或不常见特性（例如C++的多线程或内存管理）的问题很有价值。我们使用执行沙箱验证所有合成补全，确保任何合成示例都通过验证代码教授一项新技能。这种数据合成方法仅对小模型有效（即基于数据的蒸馏）。新合成方法对较大模型产生的改进微乎其微，反而需要

paras.en: human annotation and synthetic data augmentation to advance our most capable coding experts.
paras.zh: 人工标注和合成数据增强，以提升我们最强大的代码专家。

paras.en: We rely on synthetic data augmentation to diversify the style, syntax, and complexity of our code data. Our data augmentation pipeline includes prompt paraphrasing, injecting stricter requirements into prompts for more precise instruction following, and complexifying prompts similar to Magicoder (Wei et al., 2023). In verifiable scenarios, we use execution feedback to build data for code repair or translation, where iterative feedback provides guidance until the repaired code passes all tests. In a similar scenario for SQL, a repaired or translated SQL is adequate when it returns an equivalent answer from a target language database. This offline pipeline can generate prompt-completion pairs, but we also cast this iterative process into multi-turn data to simulate conversational code repair.
paras.zh: 我们依赖合成数据增强来多样化代码数据的风格、句法和复杂度。我们的数据增强流水线包括提示改写、向提示中注入更严格的要求以实现更精确的指令遵循，以及类似于 Magicoder 的提示复杂化（Wei 等，2023）。在可验证场景中，我们使用执行反馈来构建代码修复或翻译的数据，其中迭代反馈提供指导，直到修复后的代码通过所有测试。在类似的 SQL 场景中，当修复或翻译后的 SQL 从目标语言数据库返回等价答案时，即视为合格。这个离线流水线可以生成提示-补全对，但我们也把这个迭代过程转化为多轮数据，以模拟对话式代码修复。

paras.en: We also use synthetic augmentation to improve non-verifiable aspects of our data. This includes code explanations, markdown style formatting, technical precision, and global completion structure. We use reward modelling and majority voting to score these non-verifiable code completions. We also elicit feedback from human annotators to guide our data synthesis pipeline towards developer preferences for code style, structure, and explanations. This regularises against overfitting to the preferred style of any LLM judge, and our generations’ target style and structural features are actually preferred by human raters.
paras.zh: 我们还使用合成增强来改进数据中不可验证的方面。这包括代码解释、Markdown 风格格式化、技术精确度以及整体补全结构。我们使用奖励建模和多数投票来为这些不可验证的代码补全打分。我们还从人工标注者那里获取反馈，以引导我们的数据合成流水线朝向开发者对代码风格、结构和解释的偏好。这可以防止对任何 LLM 裁判的偏好风格过拟合，并且我们生成的目标风格和结构特征实际上更受人工评分者的偏好。

paras.en: 3.3.4.2 Training The code expert is trained in three stages (hyperparameters and full details in Appendix B.3):
paras.zh: 3.3.4.2 训练 代码专家分三个阶段进行训练（超参数和完整细节见附录 B.3）：

paras.en: Stage 1 is large-scale supervised learning, with the code data mixture described above. This stage includes data for all relevant tasks to optimise a high level of coding capability. To mitigate variance in initialisation, learning trajectory, and performance on small evaluation datasets we use linear merging over the top k seeds (Izmailov et al., 2018; Team et al., 2024; Yadav et al., 2024; Aakanksha et al., 2024; Khalifa et al., 2025) where k is typically 2 or 3. We observe that this merged model is a strictly superior initialisation for continued training with additional fine-tuning or RL.
paras.zh: 第一阶段是大规模监督学习，使用上述代码数据混合。该阶段包括所有相关任务的数据，以优化高水平的编码能力。为了减轻初始化、学习轨迹和小型评估数据集上性能的方差，我们使用 top k 种子的线性合并（Izmailov 等，2018；Team 等，2024；Yadav 等，2024；Aakanksha 等，2024；Khalifa 等，2025），其中 k 通常为 2 或 3。我们观察到，这个合并后的模型是一个非常优越的初始化，可用于继续进行额外的微调或强化学习训练。

paras.en: Stage 2 is supervised learning on only high-quality data. From the first stage fine-tuning, we further strengthen our code expert with additional fine-tuning on our “highest-quality” code generation datasets. We define “high-quality” as verifiable human or synthetic data from our best experts, or data rated highly by internal reward models. As before, we train multiple candidate models and merge across random seeds to produce the final SFT code expert. This secondary fine-tuning stage increased our key benchmark performance with negligible regression in tasks only present in stage 1 training (e.g., SQL query optimisation).
paras.zh: 第二阶段仅对高质量数据进行监督学习。在第一阶段微调的基础上，我们通过进一步微调我们的“最高质量”代码生成数据集来加强代码专家。我们将“高质量”定义为来自我们最优秀专家的可验证人类或合成数据，或由内部奖励模型给予高评分的数据。与之前一样，我们训练多个候选模型，并跨随机种子合并，以产生最终的 SFT 代码专家。这一二次微调阶段提高了我们的关键基准性能，而在第一阶段训练中才存在的任务（例如 SQL 查询优化）上几乎没有回退。

paras.en: Stage 3 is RL over scored or preference-pair data. We train the expert with the offline Contrastive Policy Gradient algorithm (§3.2.2), to train with execution feedback and DPO-style preference pairs as described above. To ensure stable RL, we introduce three regularization schemes. First, we repeat the Stage 2 high-quality supervised learning and merging process on any non-code expert model (e.g., a merge of multiple experts). CoPG on a merged checkpoint was strictly more stable and yielded better results than RL on top of an individual SFT/merge. Second, we introduce a hybrid cross-entropy loss function on top of CoPG to sample steps of typical supervised learning from the same Stage 2 data mix. Third, we use WARP-style merging (Ramé et al., 2024) to combine the final model trained with RL to the parent checkpoint. This hybrid approach ensures stable reinforcement learning optimization to improve both our code experts for user preference, and improving our performance on intrinsic code generation capabilities.
paras.zh: 阶段 3 是对评分数据或偏好对数据进行的强化学习（RL）。我们使用离线对比策略梯度（CoPG）算法（§3.2.2）训练专家模型，利用执行反馈和 DPO 式偏好对进行训练，如前所述。为确保强化学习的稳定性，我们引入了三种正则化方案。首先，我们对任何非代码专家模型（例如多个专家的合并模型）重复阶段 2 的高质量监督学习和合并过程。在合并检查点上使用 CoPG 比在单独 SFT/合并之上进行 RL 更加稳定，并且取得了更好的结果。其次，我们在 CoPG 之上引入混合交叉熵损失函数，以从相同的阶段 2 数据混合中采样典型的监督学习步骤。第三，我们使用 WARP 式合并（Ramé 等，2024）将经过 RL 训练的最终模型与父检查点合并。这种混合方法确保了稳定的强化学习优化，既提升了代码专家对用户偏好的满足度，也提高了我们在内在代码生成能力上的表现。

paras.en:
### 3.3.5 Math and Reasoning

Sophisticated reasoning abilities are a necessary competency area for generalisation in LLMs (Guo et al., 2025; Team et al., 2025; Toshniwal et al., 2024). We focus primarily on core mathematical reasoning as it is both intrinsically useful (e.g., in financial use cases) and yields out-of-distribution improvements in other knowledge-intensive tasks such as coding and data manipulation (Islam et al., 2023; Shao et al., 2024).
paras.zh:
### 3.3.5 数学与推理

复杂的推理能力是大语言模型（LLM）中泛化所必需的能力领域（Guo 等，2025；Team 等，2025；Toshniwal 等，2024）。我们主要关注核心数学推理，因为它既具有内在用途（例如在金融用例中），也能在编码和数据处理等其他知识密集型任务中带来分布外改进（Islam 等，2023；Shao 等，2024）。

paras.en:
### 3.3.5.1 Data

We find that training on synthetic data outperforms human-written data, so our approach is heavily weighted towards the use of synthetic examples. We use carefully curated seed prompts for few-shot generation of novel mathematical problems, and LLM-as-judge techniques to determine the correctness of novel problem-solution pairs. We find that the choices of prompt seeds, correctness validation, and final dataset filtering have a substantial impact on the quality of our reasoning-expert models.
paras.zh:
### 3.3.5.1 数据

我们发现，使用合成数据训练优于人类编写的数据，因此我们的方法大量偏向使用合成样本。我们使用精心策划的种子提示进行少样本生成新数学问题，并采用 LLM 作为裁判（LLM-as-judge）的技术来判断新问题—解答对的正确性。我们发现，提示种子、正确性验证和最终数据集过滤的选择对我们推理专家模型的质量有重大影响。

paras.en:
### 3.3.5.2 Training

**Supervised Fine-Tuning.** For SFT, we leverage synthetic mathematical reasoning datasets that have undergone extensive LLM-driven filtering for solution correctness. We find, similar to Toshniwal et al. (2024), that strict correctness cut-offs are not needed for optimal SFT performance.
paras.zh:
### 3.3.5.2 训练

**监督微调（SFT）。** 对于 SFT，我们利用经过了广泛的 LLM 驱动的正确性过滤的合成数学推理数据集。我们发现，类似于 Toshniwal 等人（2024）的研究，对于最佳的 SFT 性能，并不需要严格的正确性截断。

paras.en: **Preference Tuning.** We employ preference tuning following SFT across one of two datasets, dependent on the downstream model training stages: The first dataset is comprised of human-rated preferences on paired completions to reasoning prompts. The second, fully-synthetic dataset comprises correct and incorrect paired solutions to reasoning prompts. We find that, unlike in SFT, solution correctness is of critical importance in preference training (e.g., so that preferences are not accidentally inverted), and in the absence of human-written ratings, we use a mixture of programmatic and model-driven verifiers to evaluate solution correctness.
paras.zh: **偏好调整。** 我们在 SFT 之后采用偏好调整，根据下游模型训练阶段在两个数据集之一上进行：第一个数据集包含人类评分的偏好，这些偏好针对推理提示的配对补全。第二个全合成数据集包含推理提示的配对解决方案，其中既有正确的也有不正确的。我们发现，与 SFT 不同，在偏好训练中，解决方案的正确性至关重要（例如，这样可以避免偏好发生意外颠倒），在没有人类编写评分的情况下，我们使用程序化和模型驱动的验证器混合来评估解决方案的正确性。

paras.en: Merging. We find that using candidate models exhibiting maximal reasoning performance is sometimes detrimental to the cross-capability merge under particular merging strategies. We observe that optimal merged performance is achieved when first merging various reasoning-tuned and instruction-tuned expert models, and this yields a sufficiently high-signal proxy for selecting Pareto-optimal candidates to merge with a broader mix of models downstream. We employ this selection for our final set of candidate models, with the exact selection criteria along the Pareto frontier being dependent on downstream merging strategies.
paras.zh: 合并。我们发现,在某些特定合并策略下,使用展现出最大推理性能的候选模型有时反而对跨能力合并不利。我们观察到,当首先合并各种经过推理调优和指令调优的专家模型时,能获得最优的合并性能,这为选择帕累托最优候选提供了一个足够高信号的代理指标,以便与更广泛的下游模型混合合并。我们对最终的候选模型集采用了这一选择方法,沿帕累托前沿的具体选择标准取决于下游合并策略。

paras.en: Training hyperparameters for SFT and preference tuning are in Appendix B.4.
paras.zh: SFT 和偏好调优的训练超参数见附录 B.4。

paras.en: 3.3.6 Long Context Data. Given the complexity of human annotation for long-context tasks, we synthetically generate long-context examples. We sample from our long-context pretraining dataset and prompt Command R+ Refresh to generate question-answer pairs based on randomly selected fragments within 8,192 tokens (Xiong et al., 2024). To ensure high-quality, we use our reward model to select the best generation from a pool of candidates. The selected question-answer pairs are then concatenated to the original samples to construct our synthetic data.
paras.zh: 3.3.6 长上下文数据。鉴于长上下文任务的人工标注复杂性,我们合成生成长上下文示例。我们从长上下文预训练数据集中采样,并提示 Command R+ Refresh 根据 8,192 个 token 内随机选取的片段生成问答对(Xiong 等,2024)。为确保质量,我们使用奖励模型从一组候选生成中挑选最佳结果。然后将选出的问答对与原始样本拼接,构建我们的合成数据。

paras.en: Training. We perform one stage of SFT on top of the pretrained model, following a similar approach to our cooldown phase. We use an interleaved training regime with datasets of 16k and 256k sequence lengths at a 3:1 interleaving ratio. Hyperparameters are in Appendix B.5.
paras.zh: 训练。我们在预训练模型之上执行一个阶段的 SFT,采用与冷却阶段类似的方法。我们使用交替训练机制,16k 和 256k 序列长度的数据集按 3:1 的交替比例混合。超参数见附录 B.5。

paras.en: 3.3.7 Safety. AI Safety focuses on quantifying and mitigating harms that can occur from using a given AI model, either to the end user, to the company deploying it, or to society at large. Harms can arise from a single piece of generated content (e.g. hate speech). They can also be distribution-based, which is the case when the model is biased towards certain groups. This section focuses on model safety at the instance level, that is, how we decrease the risks stemming from single generative instances of a given model. We include a distribution-based evaluation (§4.6) and consider it to be a form of robustness (Seshadri & Goldfarb-Tarrant, 2025).
paras.zh: 3.3.7 安全性。AI 安全专注于量化和减轻使用给定 AI 模型可能产生的危害,无论是对最终用户、部署该模型的公司,还是对整个社会。危害可能来自单条生成内容(例如仇恨言论),也可能是基于分布的,例如模型对某些群体存在偏见时。本节关注实例层面的模型安全性,即我们如何降低给定模型的单个生成实例所带来的风险。我们还在 §4.6 中纳入了基于分布的评估,并将其视为一种鲁棒性形式(Seshadri 和 Goldfarb-Tarrant,2025)。

paras.en:
Cohere's core Safety behaviour. We focus on practical safety considerations, driven by both model capabilities and deployment use cases. We consider two main settings in which our models can be deployed:

- **The Default setting**, in which the model is used entirely outside of Cohere (e.g. open weights release). In this scenario, we lack control of the preamble structure and deployment context. We ensure that the model behaves according to Cohere's Core Safety behaviour in this general setting.
- **The Enterprise setting**, in which the model is deployed by Cohere to one of our enterprise partners.
paras.zh:
Cohere 的核心安全行为。我们聚焦于实际安全考量，这些考量同时由模型能力与部署用例驱动。我们考虑模型可以部署的两种主要场景：

- **默认场景（Default setting）**：模型完全在 Cohere 之外使用（例如开放权重发布）。在这种情况下，我们无法控制 preamble（提示前缀）的结构和部署上下文。我们确保模型在此通用场景中按照 Cohere 的核心安全行为行事。
- **企业场景（Enterprise setting）**：模型由 Cohere 部署给我们的某个企业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The safety behaviour of the model is controllable by the preamble, to meet different enterprise needs exceeding Core Safety behaviour. The controllable behaviours are called "Safety modes". There are currently two safety modes: contextual, and strict.
paras.zh: 在这里，模型的安全行为可以通过 preamble（提示前缀）进行控制，以满足超出核心安全行为范围的不同企业需求。这些可控行为称为“安全模式（Safety modes）”。目前有两种安全模式：上下文模式（contextual）和严格模式（strict）。

paras.en: Our Core Safety behaviour focuses on five key areas where we want to prevent the purposeful propagation of harmful content online: Violence and hate, Misinformation, Self-harm, Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (CSEA), and Sexual content. In the default setting, we expect the model to be able to answer requests for information on those topics (covering factual elements such as statistics, educational content); however it should not generate any unsafe content, that is, supporting, encouraging or otherwise enabling harm. In the enterprise setting, the contextual mode is similar, but allows sexual content. The model behaviour can be made stricter by using the strict mode, which prevents the model from covering any topic related to our key focus areas, as well as from generating profanity.
paras.zh: 我们的核心安全行为聚焦于我们希望防止有害内容在网上被蓄意传播的五个关键领域：暴力与仇恨、错误信息、自残、儿童性剥削和虐待（CSEA）以及色情内容。在默认场景中，我们期望模型能够回答有关这些主题的信息请求（涵盖统计数据、教育内容等事实性内容）；但它不应生成任何不安全内容，即支持、鼓励或以其他方式助长伤害的内容。在企业场景中，上下文模式与之类似，但允许色情内容。通过使用严格模式，可以使模型行为更加严格；该模式阻止模型涉及与我们的关键领域相关的任何主题，也阻止其生成亵渎性语言。

paras.en: **Data pre-training.** We perform two stages of safety-related pre-training filtering: first, we remove known domains for CSEA and sexual content, and second, we use a classifier to remove generally low quality content, including sexual content.
paras.zh: **数据预训练。** 我们执行两个阶段的安全相关预训练过滤：首先，我们移除已知的 CSEA 和色情内容域名；其次，我们使用分类器移除一般低质量的内容，包括色情内容。

paras.en: **Post-training.** In post-training, we use both SFT and preference datasets, with a combination of manual and automated labels. Safety annotation is performed by internal annotators and specialist external vendors, who are specifically trained for our Safety concepts and tasks. Our close interaction with internal Safety annotators provides additional benefits due to the potentially distressing nature of the data. We increase the diversity of our post-training data via both LLM 'personas' and LLM-based reformulations. We generate completions corresponding to different styles, identities and belief systems via diverse LLM personas. Additionally, we use our LLM to reformulate content (preserving overall semantics but changing form), thus increasing data diversity and making sure that the preferred completions are consistent with our refusal policy (in particular, the model should not apologise for refusing to generate unsafe content, which creates a common dataset artifact (Chen & Goldfarb-Tarrant, 2025)).
paras.zh: **后训练。** 在后训练中，我们同时使用 SFT（监督微调）和偏好数据集，并采用人工标签与自动标签相结合的方式。安全标注由内部标注员和专业外部供应商执行，他们均针对我们的安全概念和任务接受过专门培训。由于数据可能令人痛苦的性质，我们与内部安全标注员的密切互动还带来了额外的好处。我们通过 LLM 角色（personas）和基于 LLM 的重写来增加后训练数据的多样性。我们通过多样的 LLM 角色生成对应不同风格、身份和信仰体系的补全内容。此外，我们使用 LLM 对内容进行重写（保留整体语义但改变形式），从而增加数据多样性，并确保偏好的补全内容与我们的拒答策略保持一致（特别是，模型不应为拒绝生成不安全内容而道歉，因为这种道歉会造成常见的数据集伪影（artifact）（Chen & Goldfarb-Tarrant, 2025））。

paras.en: Balancing safety and refusal behaviour. Ensuring that the model cannot produce harmful content means that a lot of training data shows refusal as the preferred behaviour. It is crucial to balance such data points with authorised user requests and compliant completions to prevent the model from over-relying on refusal – as previously referred to in the literature as the balance between harmlessness and helpfulness (Bai et al., 2022). The balancing prompts can be split into two sets: user requests which are information requests on safety topics, and benign user requests with similar vocabulary and structure as unsafe prompts.
paras.zh: 平衡安全性与拒绝行为。确保模型不能生成有害内容意味着大量训练数据将拒绝作为首选行为。至关重要的是，要用授权用户请求和合规完成来平衡这些数据点，以防止模型过度依赖拒绝——正如文献中先前所说的无害性与有用性之间的平衡（Bai et al., 2022）。平衡提示可分为两组：用户请求（即关于安全主题的信息请求）和良性用户请求（其词汇和结构与不安全提示相似）。

paras.en: 3.3.7.2 Training Improving overall model safety means finding a fine balance between over- and under-refusal. We find it crucial to split datasets in two: namely in their safety-increasing (where the model should refuse) and helpfulness-inducing (where the model should answer) components. This allows us to balance these aspects differently during training. We use both SFT and offline preference tuning. We find offline preference tuning crucial in limiting over-refusal, however, it is less efficient than SFT at making the model safer. We observe this behaviour both on 8B models and 111B models, with the main difference between the two regimes being the effect of regularisation, with larger models more prone to overfitting. Overall, the biggest impact on our model’s ability to respond safely and helpfully is achieved in the polishing process described in Section 3.5.
paras.zh: 3.3.7.2 训练 提高模型的整体安全性意味着要在过度拒绝和拒绝不足之间找到精细的平衡。我们发现将数据集一分为二至关重要：即提高安全性的部分（模型应拒绝）和促进有用性的部分（模型应回答）。这使我们能够在训练期间以不同方式平衡这些方面。我们同时使用SFT和离线偏好调整。我们发现离线偏好调整对于限制过度拒绝至关重要，但它在让模型更安全方面不如SFT高效。我们在8B模型和111B模型上都观察到了这种行为，两种规模之间的主要区别在于正则化的效果，较大的模型更容易过拟合。总体而言，对我们模型安全且有用响应能力影响最大的是第3.5节所述的打磨过程。

paras.en: The Safety expert differs from other experts in that during the preference tuning stage we combine an offline preference loss with an equally weighted SFT loss. Preference tuning focuses on reinforcing helpfulness via helpfulness preference pairs, while SFT focuses on reinforcing safety via safety-inducing data. We find that IPO and DPO perform similarly, with SLiC showing a worse trade-off between over- and under-refusal, so we use IPO. Full details on SFT and preference hyperparameters are in Appendix B.6.
paras.zh: 安全专家与其他专家的不同之处在于，在偏好调整阶段，我们将离线偏好损失与同等权重的SFT损失相结合。偏好调整侧重于通过有用性偏好对来强化有用性，而SFT侧重于通过安全诱导数据来强化安全性。我们发现IPO和DPO表现相似，而SLiC在过度拒绝和拒绝不足之间的权衡方面表现更差，因此我们使用IPO。关于SFT和偏好超参数的完整细节见附录B.6。

paras.en: 3.4.1 Definition. Model merging refers to the process of combining a set of model parameters \(\theta_i\) for \(i \in [1, K]\), into a single combined model \(\theta_{\text{merged}} = f(\theta_1, \ldots, \theta_K)\), where \(f(\cdot)\) is some merging function. The merging function can range in complexity from simple averaging (Izmailov et al., 2018; Wortsman et al., 2022; Li et al., 2022) to methods based on Fisher information (Matena & Raffel, 2022) and sign agreement between models (Yadav et al., 2023; Yu et al., 2024). Model merging produces a single set of model parameters, resulting in faster inference than ensembling and lower memory requirements than runtime query routing.
paras.zh: 3.4.1 定义。模型合并是指将一组模型参数 \(\theta_i\)（其中 \(i \in [1, K]\)）组合成单个合并模型 \(\theta_{\text{merged}} = f(\theta_1, \ldots, \theta_K)\) 的过程，其中 \(f(\cdot)\) 是某个合并函数。合并函数的复杂度可以涵盖从简单平均（Izmailov et al., 2018; Wortsman et al., 2022; Li et al., 2022）到基于 Fisher 信息（Matena & Raffel, 2022）以及模型间符号一致性的方法（Yadav et al., 2023; Yu et al., 2024）。模型合并产生单组模型参数，因此推理速度比集成更快，内存需求低于运行时查询路由。

paras.en: Expert 1 (Model Checkpoint) + Expert 2 (Model Checkpoint) = Merged Model
paras.zh: 专家 1（模型检查点）+ 专家 2（模型检查点）= 合并模型

paras.en: Capability 1, Capability 2; Capability 1, Capability 2; Capability 1, Capability 2
paras.zh: 能力 1、能力 2；能力 1、能力 2；能力 1、能力 2

paras.en: 3.4.2 Merging Taxonomy. We here list the different merging techniques, each using different models and having different goals.
paras.zh: 3.4.2 合并分类法。这里我们列出不同的合并技术，每种技术使用不同的模型，且目标不同。

paras.en: Expert merging. Expert merging refers to the process of combining a set of models with different capabilities to produce a single monolithic model with those capabilities. In this setting, the input models will likely be trained on various datasets and exhibit performance along a single domain only. The aim is to produce a single set of parameters that preserves as much of the individual ‘expert’ performance as possible. Expert merging is a core feature of the Command A training pipeline, and we describe it in more detail in §3.4.3.
paras.zh: 专家合并。专家合并是指将一组具有不同能力的模型合并为单个整体模型，使其具备这些能力。在这种情况下，输入模型很可能是在不同数据集上训练的，并且仅在单一领域表现出性能。目标是产生一组参数，尽可能保留各个‘专家’的性能。专家合并是 Command A 训练流程的核心特性，我们将在 §3.4.3 中更详细地描述。

paras.en: Merging as Polyak averaging. Merging may be used to achieve a form of Polyak averaging (Ruppert, 1988; Polyak & Juditsky, 1992). Here, the input models are checkpoints from different points along a single training run, and merging acts as a smoothing operation that reduces the effects of noise inherent in stochastic gradient-based optimisation.
paras.zh: 作为 Polyak 平均的合并。合并可用于实现一种 Polyak 平均（Ruppert, 1988; Polyak & Juditsky, 1992）。在这里，输入模型是同一训练过程中不同时间点的检查点，合并作为一种平滑操作，可减少基于随机梯度的优化所固有的噪声影响。

paras.en: Seed merging. Merging may also reduce the effects of random seeds (e.g., for initialization or data loader ordering). Merging the final checkpoints from multiple equivalent training runs with different random seeds can reduce the risk of overfitting and lead to a more robust model.
paras.zh: 种子合并。合并还可以减少随机种子（例如初始化或数据加载顺序）的影响。将来自多个具有不同随机种子的等效训练运行的最终检查点合并，可以降低过拟合风险，并产生更稳健的模型。

paras.en: Interpolation for capability recovery. We observe multiple instances of capability forgetting (Kirkpatrick et al., 2017), whereby training an expert on one capability degrades performance on other capabilities. This is a particular issue for long-context abilities since experts are generally trained on top of a long-context capable model but with training schemes that use short context lengths. In this situation, merging an expert with the original base model can recover a significant proportion of the original capability while retaining the new expert capability. This setting is closely related to the WARP approach (Ramé et al., 2024).
paras.zh: 用于能力恢复的插值。我们观察到多次能力遗忘（Kirkpatrick et al., 2017），即在某一能力上训练专家模型会降低其他能力的性能。这对长上下文能力来说尤其成问题，因为专家模型通常在具有长上下文能力的模型之上训练，但训练方案使用的上下文长度较短。在这种情况下，将专家模型与原始基础模型合并，可以在保留新的专家能力的同时，恢复原始能力的很大一部分。这种设置与 WARP 方法（Ramé et al., 2024）密切相关。

paras.en: 3.4.3 Expert Merging. The overall goal for an enterprise-ready LLM is a single monolithic model, with multiple capabilities. These capabilities can sometimes be orthogonal (e.g., code and safety competencies have very different data distributions) and may involve different scales of training data. For example, it is more straightforward to generate high volumes of synthetic data in more easily verifiable domains, such as code and reasoning, compared to domains like safety or RAG, where human-annotated data is more prevalent. These differences introduce technical and operational challenges: how can we enable asynchronous development of model capabilities, and jointly optimise for a range of capabilities with highly varied training dynamics?
paras.zh: 3.4.3 专家合并。企业级 LLM 的总体目标是打造一个具有多种能力的单一单体模型。这些能力有时可能是正交的（例如，代码和安全能力的数据分布差异很大），并且可能涉及不同规模的数据训练。例如，与安全或 RAG 等领域相比，在代码和推理等更容易验证的领域中，生成大量合成数据更为直接，而安全或 RAG 等领域则更多地依赖人工标注数据。这些差异带来了技术和运营上的挑战：我们如何实现模型能力的异步开发，并针对训练动态差异很大的多种能力进行联合优化？

paras.en: Model merging enables multiple teams to work asynchronously on improving different capabilities, with their contributions merged together in parameter space. The capabilities exhibited by Command A cover a wide range of data scales, that would be non-trivial to combine into a single dataset and optimisation strategy. Merging allows each team to separately optimise hyperparameters and data scale for peak performance on their capability of interest. Our final model was informed by 500 separate evaluation metrics, which would have been significantly less practical in a more centralised organisational structure. Merging is computationally cheap, allowing us to quickly and easily rebalance the capabilities of the final model.
paras.zh: 模型合并使多个团队能够异步改进不同能力，并将他们的贡献在参数空间中合并在一起。Command A 所展现的能力涵盖了广泛的数据规模，将这些能力组合到单一数据集和优化策略中并非易事。合并使每个团队能够针对其感兴趣的能力，分别优化超参数和数据规模，以获得最佳性能。我们的最终模型参考了 500 项独立的评估指标，而在更为集中的组织结构中，这种做法将远不那么实际。合并的计算成本很低，使我们能够快速、轻松地重新平衡最终模型的能力。

paras.en: We apply merging at two points in the overall training pipeline: firstly, to combine a set of expert models trained using SFT into an initial ‘SFT model soup’; secondly, to combine a set of experts that were trained using offline preference optimisation techniques on top of the SFT soup, giving an ‘off-pref soup’. At both stages, our aim is to jointly maintain as high a proportion of the expert capability as possible while also allowing for rebalancing of the overall capabilities of the final model.
paras.zh: 我们在整体训练管道的两个时间点应用合并：首先，将一组使用 SFT 训练的专家模型组合成初始的“SFT 模型汤”；其次，在 SFT 汤之上将一组使用离线偏好优化技术训练的专家组合起来，得到“离线偏好汤”。在这两个阶段，我们的目标是尽可能保留专家能力的高比例，同时允许对最终模型的整体能力进行再平衡。

paras.en: **3.4.3.1 Linear merging is simple but effective.** We employ linear merging (also known as weight averaging), with weights chosen by manual search. We find that, broadly speaking, the interaction between expert weights and resulting model performance is fairly intuitive; increasing the weight of a domain expert is likely to increase performance in that domain. However, this relationship is not perfect, and the corresponding degradation in performance of other (implicitly downweighted[^2]) domains is much less predictable. We therefore search across merging weights using a combination of heuristics (i.e., upweight experts for domains in which a merge candidate is underperforming) and brute force search (i.e., perturb the weights for each expert, centred around the current candidate). We experimented with more complex merging methods (e.g., SLERP (Ramé et al., 2024) and task vectors (Ilharco et al., 2023)) but found no significant performance improvements, at the cost of increased complexity. In addition, linear merging is associative, meaning that a linear merge of linear merges can be expressed as a single merge operation, improving the interpretability of a complex training pipeline.
paras.zh: **3.4.3.1 线性合并简单而有效。** 我们采用线性合并（又称权重平均），权重通过手动搜索选择。我们发现，总体而言，专家权重与最终模型性能之间的交互相当直观：增加某个领域专家的权重很可能会提高该领域的性能。然而，这种关系并不完美，其他（隐式降权[^2]）领域的性能相应下降则远不那么可预测。因此，我们结合启发式方法（即对合并候选者表现不佳的领域的专家进行升权）和暴力搜索（即以当前候选者为中心扰动每个专家的权重）来搜索合并权重。我们尝试了更复杂的合并方法（如 SLERP (Ramé et al., 2024) 和任务向量 (Ilharco et al., 2023)），但发现性能没有显著提升，反而增加了复杂度。此外，线性合并具有结合性，即线性合并的线性合并可以表示为单个合并操作，从而提高了复杂训练管道的可解释性。

paras.en:
**3.4.3.2 Consistency is more important than optimality.** All expert models are initialised from a common ‘general instruction following’ model, for two reasons. Firstly, some domain experts make use of special tokens (e.g., tool calls) whose embeddings otherwise remain untrained. We find that selectively merging these embeddings only from checkpoints where they are trained is beneficial, but suboptimal. Using a shared generalised instruction-following model as initialisation for each expert and merging the special token embeddings as normal performs much better, even though these embeddings are likely to be lower quality. Secondly, we find that the post-training process generally degrades long-context performance, and that this is challenging to recover. Starting from a generalised model that is ‘long-context capable’ preserves long-context performance more easily throughout the training pipeline. We find it valuable to include ‘leave-one-out’ merges as part of the search process, to reveal instances where one expert model causes performance degradation of others, or ‘collisions’. To address this, we include a small amount of cross-domain data in each expert’s training, to act as a regulariser and ensure that each expert remains ‘compatible’ with the other experts. We also observe that collisions can be caused by small inconsistencies in the style or formatting of the common data between experts. In combination this implies that maintaining some consistency between expert models is more important than absolute expert performance.

**Footnote 2:** For linear merging, the weights must sum to 1. Increasing the weight of one expert therefore requires reducing the weight of another.
paras.zh:
**3.4.3.2 一致性比最优性更重要。** 所有专家模型都从同一个“通用指令跟随”模型初始化，原因有二。首先，某些领域专家会使用特殊 token（如工具调用），否则这些 token 的嵌入会保持未训练。我们发现，仅从经过训练的检查点中选择性合并这些嵌入是有益的，但并非最优。使用共享的通用指令跟随模型作为每个专家的初始化，并正常合并特殊 token 嵌入，效果要好得多，尽管这些嵌入可能质量较低。其次，我们发现后训练过程通常会降低长上下文性能，而且这个问题很难恢复。从一个“具备长上下文能力”的通用模型开始，可以在整个训练管道中更容易地保持长上下文性能。我们发现，将“留一法”合并纳入搜索过程很有价值，可以揭示某个专家模型导致其他专家性能下降的情况，即“碰撞”。为了解决这个问题，我们在每个专家的训练中加入了少量跨领域数据，作为正则化器，以确保每个专家与其他专家保持“兼容”。我们还观察到，碰撞可能由专家之间公共数据的风格或格式上的微小不一致引起。综合来看，这意味着保持专家模型之间的一致性比绝对专家性能更重要。

**脚注 2：** 对于线性合并，权重之和必须为 1。因此，增加一个专家的权重就需要降低另一个专家的权重。

paras.en: **3.4.3.3 Merging is cheap, evaluation is expensive.** We note that most prior work on model merging assumes that the set of input experts is fixed, and seeks to find a single merging method that optimises some value function, generally a single metric or small number of metrics (e.g., Wang et al., 2024a). These methods often involve a large number of hyperparameters (Ilharco et al., 2023) or extensive search over merge weights (Khalifa et al., 2025). By contrast, our goal is to optimise for a wide range of capabilities and many metrics. This introduces a further challenge generally not acknowledged by the literature; while model merging is cheap and fast, evaluating each merge requires significant inference time and compute. Evaluation is therefore a significant bottleneck when applying model merging in a production context. The set of input models is also not fixed, and a significant portion of the effort towards successful merging involves making changes to the training scheme used by the experts.
paras.zh: **3.4.3.3 合并便宜，评估昂贵。** 我们注意到，大多数先前的模型合并工作都假设输入专家集是固定的，并试图找到一种单一的合并方法来优化某个价值函数，通常是一个或少数几个指标（如 Wang 等，2024a）。这些方法通常涉及大量超参数（Ilharco 等，2023）或对合并权重进行广泛搜索（Khalifa 等，2025）。相比之下，我们的目标是优化广泛的能力和许多指标。这带来了一个文献中通常未提及的进一步挑战：虽然模型合并便宜且快速，但评估每次合并需要大量的推理时间和算力。因此，在生产环境中应用模型合并时，评估是一个重要的瓶颈。输入模型集也不是固定的，成功合并的很大一部分努力涉及对专家训练方案的更改。

paras.en: We apply merging at two points in the overall training pipeline: firstly, to combine a set of expert models trained using SFT into an initial ‘SFT model soup’; secondly, to combine a set of experts that were trained using offline preference optimisation techniques on top of the SFT soup, giving an ‘off-pref soup’. At both stages, our aim is to jointly maintain as high a proportion of the expert capability as possible while also allowing for rebalancing of the overall capabilities of the final model.

Model merging provides a powerful mechanism for combining a diverse set of experts into a single model. However, combining experts trained to target specific capabilities does not guarantee the final model’s alignment with human preferences. To address this, we introduce a polishing phase as the final post-training step. This phase serves two critical purposes: fixing any artifacts introduced during model merging and aligning the final model with human preferences.
paras.zh: 模型合并为将不同专家组合成单一模型提供了强大机制。然而，合并针对特定能力训练的专家并不保证最终模型与人类偏好对齐。为解决这一问题，我们引入一个打磨阶段作为最后的后训练步骤。该阶段有两个关键目的：修复模型合并过程中引入的任何伪影，以及使最终模型与人类偏好对齐。

paras.en: Unlike other specific capabilities such as coding or instruction-following, human alignment has a cross-domain effect and influences every aspect of the model’s behavior. The polishing phase ensures that the model adheres to human expectations, including tone and style, without sacrificing technical competence.
paras.zh: 与其他特定能力（如编码或指令遵循）不同，人类对齐具有跨领域效应，影响模型行为的每个方面。打磨阶段确保模型符合人类期望，包括语气和风格，而不牺牲技术能力。

paras.en: Polishing is divided into three steps. First, we apply SFT on a subset of our highest quality datasets. Second, we apply offline preference tuning, and finally, we apply online Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We find that ping-pong-style interleaving of offline and online preference learning helps improve alignment with human preferences while avoiding regressions and mitigating reward model hacking.
paras.zh: 打磨分为三个步骤。首先，我们在最高质量数据集的子集上应用SFT。其次，应用离线偏好调优，最后应用在线基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）。我们发现，类似乒乓球的离线与在线偏好学习交替进行有助于改善与人类偏好的对齐，同时避免性能回退并缓解奖励模型欺骗。

paras.en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). We employ a best-of-N SFT approach (Stiennon et al., 2020) where we synthetically generate four candidate completions for each prompt. We leverage our reward model (§3.2.3) trained on human preference data to rank these completions. We then apply SFT using the highest-ranked completions, ensuring that the model learns from the most highly rewarded responses.
paras.zh: 监督微调（SFT）。我们采用最佳N选一的SFT方法（Stiennon等人，2020），即为每个提示词合成生成四个候选补全。我们利用基于人类偏好数据训练得到的奖励模型（§3.2.3）对这些补全进行排序。然后，我们使用排名最高的补全应用SFT，确保模型从奖励最高的响应中学习。

paras.en: Preference Tuning. We use offline preference training to align our model with human preferences. We select completions with the highest reward scores as preferred completions, and use the completions with the lowest reward scores as dispreferred. Additionally, we refine the dataset by filtering out prompts exhibiting a low average reward. To further improve the model’s proficiency in instruction-following, mathematical reasoning, and coding, we incorporate domain-specific preference data into our training mixture. For instruction-following, completions that correctly adhere to all instructions are considered preferred, while completions failing to meet all instruction criteria are labeled as dispreferred. To construct preference data for mathematical reasoning, we categorize completions that yield correct answers as preferred and those failing to produce accurate solutions as dispreferred. Similarly, for code generation tasks, code snippets passing all unit tests serve as preferred completions, while those failing the tests are used as dispreferred completions. We also filter these preference datasets by removing samples for which the preferred completions are assigned a lower score than the dispreferred completions by our reward model. We rely again on the SRPO loss due to its robustness and its self-refinement abilities (§3.2.2.1). In our implementation of SRPO, following Grinsztajn et al. (2024), we average the log-likelihoods of preferred and dispreferred completions to control for variations in the completion length.
paras.zh: 偏好调优。我们使用离线偏好训练来使模型与人类偏好对齐。我们选择奖励得分最高的补全作为偏好补全，并将奖励得分最低的补全作为非偏好补全。此外，我们通过过滤掉平均奖励较低的提示词来优化数据集。为了进一步提高模型在指令遵循、数学推理和编码方面的熟练度，我们将特定领域的偏好数据纳入训练混合数据。对于指令遵循，正确遵循所有指令的补全被视为偏好补全，而未满足所有指令标准的补全被标记为非偏好补全。为了构建数学推理的偏好数据，我们将产生正确答案的补全分类为偏好补全，而未能产生准确解决方案的补全分类为非偏好补全。类似地，对于代码生成任务，通过所有单元测试的代码片段作为偏好补全，而未通过测试的代码片段作为非偏好补全。我们还通过移除那些偏好补全被奖励模型分配低于非偏好补全得分的样本来过滤这些偏好数据集。由于SRPO损失函数的鲁棒性和自精炼能力（§3.2.2.1），我们再次依赖它。在我们的SRPO实现中，遵循Grinsztajn等人（2024）的做法，我们对偏好和非偏好补全的对数似然进行平均，以控制补全长度差异。

paras.en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). To further align our model with human preferences, we employ Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We use online CoPG (§3.2.2.2) with two generations per prompt. The prompts used for RLHF training are drawn from a subset of those previously used during SFT, including reasoning, multilingual, coding, and preference-based task prompts. We regularize training with an auxiliary L2 loss against the reference policy, and an SFT loss on a high-quality subset of post-training data.
paras.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）。为了进一步提升模型与人类偏好之间的对齐，我们采用了基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）。我们对每个提示使用在线 CoPG（§3.2.2.2），每个提示生成两个候选。用于 RLHF 训练的提示来自先前 SFT 阶段所用提示的一个子集，涵盖推理、多语言、代码和基于偏好的任务提示。我们使用相对于参考策略的辅助 L2 损失，以及在高质量后训练数据子集上计算的 SFT 损失，来对训练进行正则化。

paras.en:
**17 Area Benchmarks.**

paras.en: We report results from a diverse and extensive set of evaluations benchmarking the performance of Command A and Command R7B. We evaluate a broad range of capabilities using public academic datasets and internal evaluations. Table 2 gives an overview of the capability areas we focus on and the corresponding benchmarks. We present a snapshot of results on a representative subset of these evaluations in Table 1 opening this report. Full details for each dataset are available in the corresponding sections.
paras.zh: 我们报告了来自多样且广泛的评估集的结果，这些评估对 Command A 和 Command R7B 的性能进行了基准测试。我们使用公开学术数据集和内部评估来评估广泛的能力。表2概述了我们关注的能力领域及相应的基准。我们在本报告开头的表1中展示了这些评估中具有代表性子集的结果快照。每个数据集的完整细节可在相应章节中找到。

paras.en: We compare our models against open and closed models in similar parameter count ranges. Wherever possible, we show externally reported results with comparable evaluation settings. Where these are not available, we attempt to internally reproduce these results as faithfully as possible given the information provided publicly.
paras.zh: 我们将我们的模型与参数数量范围相似的开放和封闭模型进行比较。在可能的情况下，我们展示具有可比评估设置的外部报告结果。如果这些不可用，我们会根据公开提供的信息，尝试尽可能忠实地在内部复现这些结果。

paras.en: While our primary aim is to build a highly performant model for enterprise use cases (§4.7), we also measure performance on standard academic datasets to evaluate baseline model knowledge and capabilities. Where applicable (MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA), we follow the simple-evals implementation, including data, task settings, prompting, and answer parsing. More details can be found in Appendix B.7.

We note that academic benchmarks have various limitations such as saturation, bias and alignment to real-world performance (Kiela et al., 2021). Human assessment of model capabilities can be undesirably

18 influenced by confounders (Hosking et al., 2024), be subject to idiosyncratic, conversational and demographic variance (Kirk et al., 2024), and demonstrates imperfect correlation to academic benchmarks (Schaeffer et al., 2025). Enterprise-relevant capabilities are often not well-represented in these benchmarks, so we augment our evaluations with enterprise-oriented signal (e.g. §4.2, §4.7), and human annotation based evaluation (§4.11).

Command A supports 23 key languages of global business: English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Dutch, Czech, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Romanian, Greek, Hindi, Hebrew, and Persian. We evaluate performance on many of these languages (and beyond) on both academic and internal enterprise-focused benchmarks, as well as public benchmarks important for business use such as language consistency and steerability, and dialect awareness.
paras.zh: Command A 支持全球商务的 23 种主要语言：英语、法语、西班牙语、意大利语、德语、葡萄牙语、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语、中文、俄语、波兰语、土耳其语、越南语、荷兰语、捷克语、印度尼西亚语、乌克兰语、罗马尼亚语、希腊语、印地语、希伯来语和波斯语。我们在许多这些语言（及其他语言）上评估性能，涵盖学术基准和内部企业级基准，以及对于商业使用重要的公共基准，如语言一致性和可引导性，以及方言意识。

paras.en: We assess the general multilingual capability of Command A through machine translation via NTREX128 (Federmann et al., 2022), which contains human-translated news-domain documents, FLORES-200 (Team et al., 2022; Goyal et al., 2022); and multilingual mathematical reasoning (MGSM; Shi et al. (2022)). We further evaluate Command A’s understanding of regional contexts through INCLUDE (Romanou et al., 2025), a large-scale region-specific evaluation suite in 44 languages.
paras.zh: 我们通过机器翻译评估 Command A 的一般多语言能力，使用的基准包括 NTREX128 (Federmann et al., 2022)，其中包含人工翻译的新闻领域文档；FLORES-200 (Team et al., 2022; Goyal et al., 2022)；以及多语言数学推理（MGSM; Shi et al. (2022)）。我们进一步通过 INCLUDE (Romanou et al., 2025) 评估 Command A 对区域语境的理解，这是一个包含 44 种语言的大规模区域特定评估套件。

paras.en: Results for machine translation on NTREX are shown in Table 7. We use the COMET-20 metric (Rei et al., 2020), one of the top-performing MT metrics (Freitag et al., 2023). Rather than mark single winning models, we mark winning clusters of models by taking into account the effect size of the metric. A model is in a winning cluster if its score difference to the best model is smaller than 1.67 points. This threshold equates to 75% agreement with humans (Kocmi et al., 2024): humans will agree with the automatic metric on 3 out of 4 pairwise system comparisons that have a difference of 1.67 COMET-20. Further academic results (MGSM and INCLUDE-44) are in Appendix B.2.
paras.zh: NTREX 上的机器翻译结果见表 7。我们使用 COMET-20 指标 (Rei et al., 2020)，这是性能最优的机器翻译指标之一 (Freitag et al., 2023)。我们不对单一获胜模型进行标记，而是通过考虑指标的效应量来标记模型获胜簇。如果某模型的分数与最佳模型之差小于 1.67 分，则该模型属于获胜簇。该阈值相当于与人类判断的一致性为 75% (Kocmi et al., 2024)：在差值为 1.67 COMET-20 的系统两两比较中，人类会在 4 次中有 3 次与自动指标一致。进一步的学术结果（MGSM 和 INCLUDE-44）见附录 B.2。

paras.en: To evaluate more general and diverse capabilities, we ran an LLM-as-judge arena-like evaluation of responses to mArenaHard, a dataset of 500 challenging queries from Chatbot Arena, originally in English, translated into 23 languages (Dang et al., 2024). As shown in Table 8, Command A is preferred across all 23 languages versus Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, Llama 3.1 405B Instruct, and DeepSeek V3.
paras.zh: 为了评估更通用和更多样的能力，我们运行了类似竞技场的 LLM 作为裁判评估，针对 mArenaHard 的响应。mArenaHard 是一个包含 500 个来自 Chatbot Arena 的挑战性查询的数据集，原始为英文，翻译成 23 种语言 (Dang et al., 2024)。如表 8 所示，在全部 23 种语言中，Command A 相比 Llama 3.3 70B Instruct、Llama 3.1 405B Instruct 和 DeepSeek V3 更受青睐。

paras.en: We also conduct a human-annotated arena-like evaluation. Figure 5 shows the results of an internal evaluation set consisting of 100 translated prompts^3 from English that focus on instruction-following ability. Command A performs favourably in multilingual head-to-head human evaluations against comparable models across 9 priority languages. Command A outperforms the Llama 3.3 70B Instruct and Llama 3.1 405B Instruct across all evaluated languages. Versus DeepSeek V3 and Mistral Large 2, Command A is favoured across 8 of 9 languages. Notably, Command A is favoured in Chinese compared to DeepSeek V3 and is favoured in French compared to Mistral Large 2. It is also favoured against GPT-4o on Arabic and Korean, and is competitive on Spanish, German, Italian, and Chinese.
paras.zh: 我们还进行了人工标注的类竞技场评估。图 5 显示了内部评估集的结果，该评估集由 100 个从英语翻译而来的提示^3 组成，重点考察指令遵循能力。在 9 种优先语言的多语言人工两两比较中，Command A 与同类模型相比表现良好。Command A 在所有被评估语言上均优于 Llama 3.3 70B Instruct 和 Llama 3.1 405B Instruct。与 DeepSeek V3 和 Mistral Large 2 相比，Command A 在 9 种语言中的 8 种上更受青睐。值得注意的是，在中文上 Command A 相比 DeepSeek V3 更受青睐，在法语上相比 Mistral Large 2 更受青睐。在与 GPT-4o 的对比中，Command A 在阿拉伯语和韩语上更受青睐，而在西班牙语、德语、意大利语和中文上则具有竞争力。
